messages:
Nora: Quick: final copy pass for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private landing pages. Need 2 headlines each, one-lined subheads, 3 social hooks, short benchmark blurb, webinar theme + CTA, and simple lead routing. 24h?
Ike: I can do Hosted + benchmark blurb. Sofia take Dedicated, Devon take Private?
Sofia: Yep. Will focus headlines on predictability and SLAs. Two variants each.
Devon: Private page will emphasize compliance, KMS, and audit logs.
Ike: Hosted headlines:
A) "Start fast with a production-hosted inference API"
B) "Low-latency hosted inference, built for engineers"
Subhead: "Streaming responses, usage analytics, and free credits."
Sofia: Dedicated headlines:
A) "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable LLM throughput"
B) "Committed pools, SLA-backed latency targets"
Subhead: "Autoscale rules, burst options, and cost predictability."
Devon: Private headlines:
A) "Private deployments: data stays in your network"
B) "On-prem/VPC inference for regulated workloads"
Subhead: "KMS/HSM support, audit trail, and private control plane."
Nora: Social hooks (short):
- "Launching: easier, faster LLM inference with predictable costs. Join our webinar."
- "Benchmark: same model, ~30% lower GPU cost with batching + KV caching. Read the blog."
- "Live demo: routing, fallback, and reserved capacity in action. Seats limited."
Ike: Benchmark blurb (short): "On a 1M-message mixed chat benchmark, Redwood reduced 95th percentile latency by ~40% and lowered GPU cost per million tokens by ~30% using workload-aware batching and prefix caching. Repro scripts: github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks."
Nora: Webinar theme: "Serving LLMs in production: latency, cost, and controls" CTA: register -> tag webinar-llm-2026. 3-email drip after.
Sofia: Lead routing (minimal): Hosted try -> growth-sdr (P3); Hosted heavy -> enterprise-sdr (P2); Dedicated reserve -> sales-enterprise (P1); Private contact -> solutions-eng (P1); Webinar reg -> nurture (P2).
marketing-bot: Event created: "Serving LLMs in production" on 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC. (automated)
Nora: Owners: Hosted (Ike), Dedicated (Sofia), Private (Devon), Social + emails (Nora). Ship first pass to /marketing/copy by EOD.
